objs.name: document
objs.description: A record containing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions that requires management through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing locally defined or business process-specific regulations and instructions.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type documenting detailed work steps, test instructions and criteria for sub-processes.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and not requiring dual control principle approval.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning through all release process statuses.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggestion for amendments to a document created by employees without affecting content or version history of the document.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity period of a document approaching expiration.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role with read and write permissions on documents and responsibility for document creation and content.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for approving and releasing documents to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with view-only access to approved documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role responsible for translating released content into other languages.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for authorization and distribution purposes.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups or persons to be notified about document releases or required to acknowledge documents.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to documents during the release process.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record of document changes and workflow activities ensuring complete traceability.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A specific iteration of a document created when content, attributes, or attachments are modified after release.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group retaining read access to archived documents after general authorization revocation.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure for a specific document type with automatic metadata insertion capability.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using the editing client and Office components.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintenance of standardized and customer-specific metadata for a document in categories.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of read and change rights to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Designation of reviewers and releasers for the document release process.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the approval process by author or co-author, starting the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Examination of document content by assigned reviewer according to technical and formal criteria.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Final authorization of document release by assigned releaser.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participant during release process.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Publication of document making it visible to addressed readers after approval.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document from source format to PDF after content save.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic generation of new document version triggered by content, attribute or attachment changes to released document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking an attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of proposed amendments to a document by employee with author rights.

evts.name: notify_change_proposal
evts.description: Automatic email notification to document author about created change proposal.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Planning of change proposal implementation triggering creation of new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Documentation of editing completion by document author for assigned change proposal.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request for validity extension created when document reaches 30 days before expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Workflow-supported process to confirm continued validity of document and update valid until date.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version for document requiring updates during validity extension check.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Workflow-supported invalidation of document with no additional validity, revoking authorizations and marking for archiving.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of previously invalidated document restoring original status and attachments.

evts.name: assign_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintenance of user groups or persons to receive document release notifications or acknowledgement requests.

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification to distributed users when new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic email request for active confirmation of document receipt by distributed users.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported confirmation of document acknowledgement by distributed user.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Language-dependent translation of released document content by translator role.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Examination of translated document content by assigned reviewer.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Authorization of translated document release by assigned releaser.

evts.name: sign_translation
evts.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participant during translation approval.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Publication of translated document version making it visible to readers in corresponding login language.

evts.name: configure_client_visibility
evts.description: Specification of which clients can access a document in a multi-client system.

o2o.description: A document contains zero or more attachments which are controlled documents released with the main document.
A document contains zero or more additional information items not subject to the main document release cycle.
A change proposal is clearly associated with a specific document and displayed within it.
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute in document properties.
A validity extension request is linked to a specific document requiring validity check.
An override request is associated with a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references a specific previously invalidated document to be restored.
A document has multiple electronic signatures from workflow participants documented in the document.
A document has an associated audit trail recording all changes and workflow activities.
A document may be created based on a template defined for its document type.
Policies can reference other policies through document references.
A guideline is a document type containing regulations and instructions.
A procedural instruction is a document type describing process sequences and procedures.
A work instruction is a document type describing detailed work steps and criteria.
An author has read and write permissions on assigned documents.
A reviewer has read and write permissions on documents requiring review.
A releaser has read and write permissions on documents requiring approval.
A reader has view-only access to approved documents assigned through distribution lists.
Reader groups can have subgroups assigned, such as location-specific user groups.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups for notification and access purposes.
A distribution list contains assigned persons to receive notifications or acknowledgements.
A document version is a specific iteration of a document created after modifications to released content.
Archive group members retain read access to archived documents after general authorization revocation.

o2e.description: A document is created by attachment of a new information object.
Document content is edited through the editing client in Office components.
Document properties and metadata are edited in categorical groups.
Read and change authorizations are assigned to users or groups for a document.
Reviewers and releasers are assigned to a document for the release process.
A document is submitted for approval starting the creator workflow step.
Assigned reviewers examine document content according to technical and formal aspects.
An assigned releaser authorizes final document release.
Workflow participants apply electronic signatures to a document during approval.
A document is published and becomes visible to addressed readers.
A document is automatically converted to PDF format after content save.
A new version of a document is automatically created when changes occur to released content.
An attachment is marked for archiving when no longer relevant to a new document version.
A change proposal is created by an employee with author rights.
The document author is notified by email about a created change proposal.
A change proposal is scheduled for implementation triggering a new document version.
The document author documents completion of editing for a change proposal.
A validity extension request is system-generated when a document approaches expiration.
A document validity is extended through workflow-supported confirmation.
A document is revised creating a new version during validity extension check.
An override request initiates workflow-supported invalidation of a document.
A reactivation request initiates restoration of a previously invalidated document.
User groups or persons are assigned to a document distribution list.
Distributed users receive automatic email notification when document is released.
Distributed users receive automatic email request to confirm document acknowledgement.
A reader confirms workflow-supported acknowledgement of a document.
A released document is translated into another language by a translator.
Assigned reviewer examines translated document content.
Assigned releaser authorizes release of translated document version.
A translator applies electronic signature during translation approval.
A translated document version is published in the corresponding language.
Client visibility is specified for a document in a multi-client system.
